name: npu-training-pitfalls index
note: error-signature-indexed pitfalls for domestic AI compute training stacks. sig is the searchable error/symptom string; entries carry root cause, fix, versions and evidence. Seed = our own verified incidents (OWN-*) + cross-referenced upstream issues (SCAN-*).

entries.title: EAGLE-3 draft accepted at construction, silently useless at inference
entries.symptom: Engine builds and serves; SpecDecoding metrics report Mean acceptance length 1.01 (5 accepted of 1720 drafted). Throughput 0.64x of baseline at k=3.

entries.sig: Qwen2.5 vocab size differs across model scales (7B=152064, 0
entries.title: Qwen2.5 vocab size differs across model scales (7B=152064, 0.5B/1.5B=151936), breaking cross-size KD logit reshapes
entries.symptom: KD with a 7B teacher onto a 0.5B student crashes at first step: reshape '[-1, 151936]' invalid for input of size 311427072 (= 8*256*152064); teacher lm_head output flattened with the student's vocab size
entries.fix: slice teacher logits to the student vocab intersection ([:, :, :min(V_s, V_t)]) and renormalize the softmax over that slice before the KL term; identical-vocab pairs are unaffected (slice is a no-op)

entries.title: OpenI Jupyter contents-API PUT returns 200 but silently leaves the file content unchanged
entries.symptom: PUT /api/contents/<file> responds 200, yet a later GET (with cache-buster) returns the pre-PUT bytes; happened during a phase where the repo git backend was also silently dropping commits
entries.fix: write files through the kernel WebSocket instead (base64 payload -> open(path,'wb').write(base64.b64decode(...))), then read the file back and grep a marker string before trusting it

entries.sig: Stale __pycache__ on NFS /tmp/code: Python imports old bytec
entries.title: Stale __pycache__ on NFS /tmp/code: Python imports old bytecode after the source file is overwritten out-of-band
entries.symptom: after overwriting a module file, the next python process still executes the previous version; identical error signature as before the fix, suggesting the edit 'did not apply'
entries.fix: shutil.rmtree('/tmp/code/__pycache__', ignore_errors=True) after every out-of-band module write, before launching the importing process

entries.title: Debug task stuck WAITING '分中心排队中' (sub-center queue) for >5 min despite earlier instant scheduling
entries.symptom: task created via 再次调试 stays WAITING; detail page hides 开始调试; list page shows a status icon with title 分中心排队中 and disabled 再次调试/删除; zero billing while WAITING
entries.fix: no user-side fix; patient auto-launcher that polls the detail page for 开始调试 and fires the full push+launch chain when it appears; deleting old stopped tasks does not affect the sub-center queue

entries.title: PyPI torch 2.10.0 aarch64 wheel is ABI-incompatible with every torch_npu 2.10.0.postX wheel
entries.symptom: import torch_npu raises RuntimeError 'Failed to load the backend extension: torch_npu' wrapping ImportError: libtorch_npu.so: undefined symbol _ZN5torch8autograd10deleteNodeEPNS0_4NodeE
entries.fix: use the Huawei-built torch 2.10.0+cpu wheel that ships inside vllm-ascend container images (PyPI plain 2.10.0 and pytorch.org cpu builds both fail); never install torch from PyPI into a torch_npu environment

entries.title: venv clone via cp -a keeps pip script shebangs pointing at the source venv
entries.symptom: all pip operations on the cloned venv (bin/pip) silently install into the ORIGINAL venv; the clone's own site-packages never change; the source venv ends up with a foreign torch/vllm combination and stops working
entries.fix: always invoke '<clone>/bin/python -m pip install ...' instead of '<clone>/bin/pip'; delete and rebuild the polluted source venv

entries.title: bash double-quote wrapping strips inner double quotes from python -c payloads
entries.symptom: python -c 'print("X")' inside a bash double-quoted command executes as print(X) -> NameError that looks like an import failure
entries.fix: use only single quotes inside python -c payloads, or pass code via base64-decoded triple-quoted blocks; never nest double quotes

entries.title: [Usage]: speculative decoding开启后无收益
entries.symptom: 开启投机解码（EAGLE/MTP 类 draft model）后性能不升反降：TPOT 45ms 恶化到 60ms，TPS 26→21 tokens/s
entries.fix: 无修复；维护者归因为 acceptance rate 过低（~40%），建议本质上是关闭投机解码即恢复基线

entries.sig: [Bug: v0.30.0] DSpark speculative decoding acceptance collap
entries.title: [Bug: v0.30.0] DSpark speculative decoding acceptance collapses to near-zero on DeepSeek-V4-Flash (worked on a 0.25.1-based build)
entries.symptom: 升级 0.30.0 后投机解码接受率坍缩到近零：mean acceptance length 4.98→1.03 tokens/step（仅 bonus token 存活），decode 慢 4.3-4.8 倍，TPOT 14.8→66.9-71.1ms，100% 请求超 25ms TPOT 阈值
entries.fix: 仅停用投机解码（TPOT 70.9→39.7ms）；无代码修复

entries.sig: [Bug]: Significant drop in DSpark/DFlash draft token accepta
entries.title: [Bug]: Significant drop in DSpark/DFlash draft token acceptance rate on Ascend 910B
entries.symptom: DSpark/DFlash 投机解码 draft 接受率仅 ~50% 出头，显著低于该模型应有水平，无任何报错
entries.fix: PR #20002：在 AscendMRotaryEmbedding.forward_oot 中把旋转后的 q/k 写回原 buffer 以恢复原地语义（含回归测试，抓取时未合并）

entries.sig: [Bug]: Long Chinese-context (≈8k+ chars) generation is corru
entries.title: [Bug]: Long Chinese-context (≈8k+ chars) generation is corrupted for a DeepSeek-V2 model on vLLM-Ascend (works <5k, works on SGLang)
entries.symptom: 长中文上下文（约 8k 字符起，后定位到 >=4.4k-5.3k tokens）输出乱码：中英混杂、U+FFFD 替换符、'###' 重复循环；<5k 字符正常，同权重在 SGLang 0.5.17 正常
entries.fix: 从 --hf-overrides 中去掉 rope_parameters 键（仅保留 max_position_embeddings，或配 VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1）即可保住全上下文且不乱码

entries.sig: mxfp8/fp8 KV cache: arbitrary-slot indexed reads return corr
entries.title: mxfp8/fp8 KV cache: arbitrary-slot indexed reads return corrupted data (paged sequential access is correct)
entries.symptom: mxfp8 KV cache 按任意 slot 索引取行返回位级损坏数据（量化 payload 被误读），而分页注意力顺序读同一 cache 完全正确；bf16 cache 无此问题 → sparse/top-k 检索路径全灭
entries.fix: 官方认可：读一份 pre-quantization 的 bf16 K/V 镜像（内存翻倍，16 层约 +4GB）；作者自研更快路径：dedup block→int8 index_select→fp32 take→e4m3/e8m0 手动解码（2.2/5.7/9.3ms，全 selectivity 位精确）

entries.title: [Bug]: resolve_block_scales silently miscomputes dequantized weights for a TP shard whose row/column range starts mid-block
entries.symptom: TP 分片的行/列范围起始于 FP8 block 中部时，反量化 scale 静默算错且形状校验通过：合成样例 66.6% 元素错（max abs diff 1.80），真实 GLM-5.3-Flash q_a_proj TP=8 分片 ~7% 相对 L2 误差、22-24% 元素错
entries.fix: 已修复：PR #20653 在权重加载时校验 block-FP8 分片对齐（issue closed as completed, 2026-11-05）

entries.sig: [Bug]: Hybrid AscendStore KV load failures are skipped and c
entries.title: [Bug]: Hybrid AscendStore KV load failures are skipped and can corrupt output
entries.symptom: Mooncake lookup 报 prefix 命中，但 AscendStore 实际部分加载失败（-704 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND）被 connector 吞掉 → decode 用未初始化 KV 生成 → 输出损坏，且同 prompt 100% 复现（换 prefix 即正常）
entries.fix: 无。期望修复：失败 block 通过 get_block_ids_with_load_errors() 上报，让调度器检测跨 group 无效 block 并重算

entries.title: [Bug]:Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE W8A8（compressed-tensors）在 vllm-ascend v0.30.0rc2 输出乱码，v0.18 正常
entries.symptom: 13 token 纯文本提示即输出乱码（'s 1 s ${ senators,is . S -/ s 曾 to心里…）；同 checkpoint/tokenizer/prompt/脚本在 0.18 正常；日志出现 'Falling back to UnquantizedLinearMethod'
entries.fix: 引用该 issue 的修复 commit 93dd945 'fix: dequantize W8A8 shared-expert gate-up exactly once'（helloyinwei, 11-12）；issue 抓取时仍 open，无正式 workaround

entries.sig: [Bug][A5] GLM-5.3-Flash fails at the first inference on the
entries.title: [Bug][A5] GLM-5.3-Flash fails at the first inference on the default A5 image: CANN 9.1.0 ships the aclnn_sparse_flash_mla header but no ascend950 kernel
entries.symptom: 服务正常启动（KV cache 37.64 GiB），首个推理请求即崩：call aclnnSparseFlashMla failed ... Check nnopExecutor != nullptr failed，8 rank 引擎全退，curl HTTP=000
entries.fix: 换 CANN 9.2.0 基础镜像（如 nightly-main-a5-openeuler），参数不变 → HTTP 200，冷启动 ~146s、热请求 3-4s；维护者确认 releases/v0.30.0rc2 已由 PR #18578 把默认 CANN_VERSION 升到 9.2.0，但 main/nightly 分支未同步，nightly-main-a5 镜像仍带坑

entries.title: [Bug]: DSV4.1-Flash w4a8 prefill crashes in aclnnIndex (compressor.wgate) — vector core exception 507035 on 910B
entries.symptom: 4P4D 部署下 4 个 prefill 节点反复重启：VllmWorker 因向量核异常（507035）死于 aclnnIndex 算子，级联 HCCL ALLGATHER/ALLTOALL 超时 → ERR00100 → HCCL watchdog → worker 死亡 → 健康 probe 503 → pod 重启；decode 节点不受影响，跨设备/跨天稳定复现（排除硬件故障）
entries.fix: 无（11-09 已 triaged，tag linfeng-yuan PTAL，无后续）

entries.sig: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graph mode adds ~5ms host-side dispatch o
entries.title: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graph mode adds ~5ms host-side dispatch overhead per prefill step on A3&A2 (vllm-ascend 0.23)
entries.symptom: 0.23 默认 FULL_AND_PIECEWISE 图模式给每个 prefill step 增加 ~5ms host 侧 dispatch 开销：~4125 token prefill 场景 TTFT +40%（40.4→55.5-60.1ms），prefill 吞吐 -30%（102,167→68,772-74,364 tok/s）；profiler 显示 NPU kernel 执行 ~16.1ms vs 墙钟 ~44ms，763 次 aclnn launch 中 682 个 host gap（均值 ~67us）
entries.fix: 无完全满意的解：作者建议保持默认（吃 TTFT +19ms 换 E2E 与 TPOT 双 -31%）；明确不要对 decode 重负载用 --enforce-eager（TPOT 12.1→29.2ms，prefill 反而更快 42.6ms）；把 prefill 长度加进 capture_sizes 会把 decode pad 到该尺寸（TTFT 171.1ms，decode 崩溃）

entries.sig: [MRV2] Qwen3.6 long-context prefill is ~36% slower on Model
entries.title: [MRV2] Qwen3.6 long-context prefill is ~36% slower on Model Runner V2: the blocking seq-len sync removes stream overlap
entries.symptom: MRV2 在 199,507 token prefill 上慢 ~35.8%（47.69s→64.75s），而 NPU op 时间仅 +0.4%、host ACL 时间 +2.4%、算子数相同——差距全在 compute stream idle（23.2s vs 6.1s，丢 ~17s allreduce/compute overlap）；129k prompt 上 +102-104%（16.5s→33.6s）
entries.fix: 关 MTP 可消除 ~82% 的 prefill 差距（71.63s→51.45s）；代码层修法：扩展 _can_skip_spec_cpu_length_sync() 覆盖能用 device 侧长度的模型（Qwen3.5/3.6 无 PCP 的 TP 场景）

entries.sig: [MRV2] Qwen3.6-35B-A3B prefill TTFT regression: host ACLNN w
entries.title: [MRV2] Qwen3.6-35B-A3B prefill TTFT regression: host ACLNN workspace/tiling is not reused
entries.symptom: MRV2 prefill TTFT +25.44%（中位 0.9867s vs 0.7867s），prefill 吞吐 2084.7 vs 2615.5 tok/s；host ACL API 时间 +35.6%：aclnnMatmulGetWorkspaceSize 0→1080 次（~104ms）、MatMulV2_Tiling 0→1912 次（~55ms）、aclnnInplaceCopyGetWorkspaceSize 368→2948 次——workspace/tiling 不再缓存复用
entries.fix: ACLNN_CACHE_LIMIT=100000（默认 10000）：MatmulGetWorkspaceSize 819→0、MatMulV2_Tiling 1194→0、GDN copy 900→0，恢复 MRV1 parity（2048-token 中位 0.5915 vs 0.5860s），长 prompt（16384-token/15 并发）反超 MRV1（1.2777 vs 1.6214s）；副作用提示：调大可能增加 CPU 内存

entries.title: [Bug]: off-stride max_num_seqs silently disables ACL graph capture for the largest batches (~7.5x slower decode)
entries.symptom: cudagraph_mode=FULL_DECODE_ONLY 时，max_num_seqs 不为 1/2/4/8 的倍数 → 最大批次无捕获图、静默 eager 回退慢 ~7.5 倍（69.4 vs 520.0 tok/s，172.79 vs 23.08 ms/step），无任何警告；max_num_seqs=20 时 6.7 倍（117.8 vs 788.7 tok/s）
entries.fix: 把 max_num_seqs 取整到 stride 上的值（16/24/...），或显式设置包含精确上限的 capture sizes（实测精确捕获 557.2 tok/s 优于 pad 到 16 的 500.2）；已修复：PR #16970 '[BugFix] Add off-stride graph capture size ceilings'，2026-09-23 closed as completed

entries.title: [Bug]: Decode throughput collapses 3-4x silently when running sequences exceed 256 per engine (tp=8, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-w8a8-mtp, Ascend 910B2)
entries.symptom: 每 engine 并发序列超过 256 后 decode 吞吐静默崩 3-4 倍（总 3048→1182 tok/s，per-step ~120→~400ms），无错误无警告，AICore 利用率 32%→8%、整卡 172W→131W；N=256 健康，N=258 即崩，悬崖精确落在 2 的幂 256
entries.fix: dp=2/tp=4 把每 engine 序列压到 <=224（总上限反升至 448，峰值 4561 tok/s）；未根治

entries.sig: [Installation]: vllm and vllm-ascend have dependency conflic
entries.title: [Installation]: vllm and vllm-ascend have dependency conflict on the version of torch
entries.symptom: 按官方文档先 pip install vllm==0.13.0 再 pip install vllm-ascend==0.13.0 → pip 依赖解析 ResolutionImpossible：'vllm 0.13.0 depends on torch==2.9.0 / vllm-ascend 0.13.0 depends on torch==2.8.0'；0.18.0 同样报错
entries.fix: 先装 vllm 再装 vllm-ascend（后者覆盖依赖版本，忽略 pip 的版本变更警告）；910C/A3 用户应直接用官方 -a3 后缀 Docker 镜像或源码编译（PyPI wheel 仅 A2）；源码编译仍会被强制拉一次 torch，改 vllm 的依赖声明无效

entries.title: pip-installed vllm-ascend wheel is A2-only (__device_type__='A2'); device-type assertion fails on Atlas 800T A3 (soc 253); no A3 wheel on PyPI
entries.symptom: PyPI 安装后在 Atlas 800T A3 (SoC 253) 上断言失败：'Current device type: A3 does not match the installed version's device type: A2'；manylinux_2_24_aarch64.whl 通用文件名不携带 A2-only 信息，0.13.0 与 0.18.0 双双中招
entries.fix: A3/310P/A5 用 WheelNext variant wheel + uv 安装（硬件自动匹配，官方文档路径）；或源码编译：SOC_VERSION=ascend910_9382 pip install -e .；计划改进 check_ascend_device_type() 报错信息把 A3 用户导向正确安装方式

entries.sig: vllm-ascend 0.23 原地改写 speculative_config 字典并注入不可序列化对象 → json
entries.title: vllm-ascend 0.23 原地改写 speculative_config 字典并注入不可序列化对象 → json.dump 崩溃
entries.symptom: 启用投机解码时服务进程在配置序列化处 json.dump 崩溃，因为框架原地改写用户传入的 speculative_config 字典并塞入不可序列化对象
entries.fix: json.dump(..., default=str) 兜底序列化

entries.title: 910C 容器需 CANN A3 专用变体（/usr/local/ascend83a3），标准 8.3.rc1 对 aclnnInplaceCopy 报 ERR00100
entries.symptom: 标准 CANN 8.3.rc1 环境在 910C 上运行时 aclnnInplaceCopy 报 ERR00100；切换到 CANN A3 专用变体（容器内路径 /usr/local/ascend83a3）后正常
entries.fix: 910C 容器必须使用 CANN A3 专用变体镜像/工具链（/usr/local/ascend83a3），不能用通用 8.3.rc1

entries.title: 调试任务被调度到 Alarm 坏卡 → ACL 507034，重建容器解决
entries.symptom: 调试任务分到集群中带 Alarm 标记的坏卡，运行报 ACL 507034；重建容器（重新调度到健康卡）后问题消失
entries.fix: 重建容器让调度器重新分配卡；集群层面应把 Alarm 卡排除出可调度池

entries.sig: vLLM 0.10.x 系列在 Python 3.13 上装不上（版本墙）
entries.title: vLLM 0.10.x 系列在 Python 3.13 上装不上（版本墙）
entries.symptom: pip 安装 vLLM 0.10.x 在 Python 3.13 解释器上失败——该版本线未适配 3.13，无兼容 wheel
entries.fix: 降级解释器到该版本线支持的 Python（<=3.12）；或换更高 vLLM 版本线

entries.sig: transformers 过新版本删除属性 → 必须钉 4.56.2
entries.title: transformers 过新版本删除属性 → 必须钉 4.56.2
entries.symptom: transformers 过新版本删除了 vLLM 依赖的属性，模型加载/运行时报属性缺失错误；钉回 transformers==4.56.2 后恢复
entries.fix: requirements 中显式钉 transformers==4.56.2，禁止浮动升级

entries.sig: pip 偶发报错触发回退分支装 torch 2.11 混栈 → 必须钉版 + 失败原样重试
entries.title: pip 偶发报错触发回退分支装 torch 2.11 混栈 → 必须钉版 + 失败原样重试
entries.symptom: pip 安装过程中偶发网络/解析报错后，安装脚本回退分支拉取 torch 2.11，形成与预期版本矩阵不一致的混栈环境，运行期行为异常
entries.fix: 所有依赖显式钉版；pip 失败时原样重试同一命令，绝不走参数不同的回退分支

entries.sig: vLLM 0.10.2 AWQ 内核在 sm75（无 Marlin）decode 效率 η≈0.07-0.19（内核路径
entries.title: vLLM 0.10.2 AWQ 内核在 sm75（无 Marlin）decode 效率 η≈0.07-0.19（内核路径成熟度问题，非算力问题）
entries.symptom: AWQ 量化模型在 sm75 架构 GPU 上 decode 有效算力利用率仅 ~7%-19%，远低于同硬件 FP16 基线的合理水平
entries.fix: sm75 上避开 AWQ 路径（用 FP16 或换支持 Marlin 的架构/版本）；或升级到带对应反量化内核的 vLLM 版本

entries.sig: vllm-ascend 全家桶 venv 在 /root/vllm-ascend，默认 python3 内核为空壳
entries.title: vllm-ascend 全家桶 venv 在 /root/vllm-ascend，默认 python3 内核为空壳
entries.symptom: 容器内默认 python3 不是栈所属解释器（空壳），全家桶 venv 实际位于 /root/vllm-ascend；用错解释器则 import 失败或行为诡异
entries.fix: 显式使用 /root/vllm-ascend 下的 venv 解释器（或 source 其 activate），不信任容器默认 python3

entries.title: F.linear fp16 fails on 910B 32G (soc 104) with CANN 9.0 + torch_npu 2.10
entries.symptom: MatMul error 500002 + 'TransData groups should be greater than 1'; vLLM Qwen3 startup crashes; Can not support soc_version: 104
entries.fix: upgrade CANN/torch_npu pairing; verify soc support matrix

entries.sig: E90003 bfloat16 of tbe.dsl.transdata is not supported
entries.title: bf16 fine-tune crashes at forward: TBE TransData does not support bfloat16 (CANN 8.0 + torch_npu 2.1)
entries.symptom: E90003: Compile operator failed ... bfloat16 of tbe.dsl.transdata is not supported (TransData_17)
entries.fix: move to 910B2 + newer CANN/torch_npu

entries.sig: FlexAttention is only supported on CUDA, CPU or HPU
entries.title: flex_attention unsupported on NPU
entries.symptom: training throws 'FlexAttention is only supported on CUDA, CPU or HPU'
entries.fix: partial: sparse block attention (CANN9); otherwise refactor attention path

entries.title: F.cross_entropy(ignore_index=-100, label_smoothing=0.1) backward crashes ACL stream
entries.symptom: async 507018 during loss.backward(), ACL stream corrupted; CPU fine
entries.fix: manual log_softmax + gather; retest on CANN 9.1 (910B2 passes our probe)

entries.title: GroupNorm backward silently returns zero/wrong grads on aclnn eager path
entries.symptom: fp32 GroupNorm forward ok, backward dx/dweight all zero or distorted (dx_cos 0.000-0.806)
entries.fix: jit_compile=True path passes; verify per-stack

entries.title: torch.signbit fp16 returns False for -0.0 on 910B2 (jit/eager/compile all)
entries.symptom: specials [-0.0] signbit False; 2^20 random elements 0 mismatch; CUDA correct
entries.root_cause: NPU kernel/adapter treats -0.0 sign as positive
entries.fix: avoid sign-branching on signed zero; check per CANN version

entries.title: cross_entropy accepts int32 class-index targets on NPU (CUDA rejects)
entries.symptom: no error; loss values match int64 reference; same code crashes only later on CUDA
entries.root_cause: missing dtype boundary check at cross_entropy dispatch
entries.fix: cast targets to int64 explicitly; boundary-check patch proposed upstream

entries.sig: ERR02200 DIST call hccl api failed
entries.title: 2-node HCCL allreduce failure during dp+pp pretraining
entries.symptom: ERR02200 on two 910B servers; checkpoint save failures after full SFT on 2x8x910B
entries.fix: match CANN/HCCL versions; official FAQ path; no root fix public

entries.title: DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 on NPU: no_sync assertion + EE1001 stream sync bug
entries.symptom: no_sync context manager incompatible with gradient partitioning; rtStreamWaitEvent/EE1001 in loss.backward()
entries.fix: hand-edit deepspeed/utils/timer.py:39; or accelerate launch + fsdp (maintainer advice)

entries.title: VLM full fine-tune dies unfreezing vision tower (Qwen2-VL)
entries.symptom: OPS function error: Conv3DBackpropFilter; torch 2.1/2.3/2.4 same
entries.fix: freeze vision tower; await kernel

entries.title: QLoRA impossible on NPU: bitsandbytes has no NPU backend in released wheels
entries.symptom: QLoRA attempts stall; users strip bitsandbytes entirely
entries.fix: wait for multi-backend refactor; use INT8/W8A8 alternatives

entries.title: Megatron config parity gap: NV-valid parallel config fails on MindSpeed with same card count
entries.symptom: TP=4/PP=4/EP=8 works on 32 NVIDIA cards, fails on 32x910B with divisibility error
entries.fix: rearrange parallel groups per MindSpeed rules; no auto-mapping

entries.title: 910B training hits aicore illegal instruction in NLLLoss then ACL stream sync fails
entries.symptom: DeepSpeed #4892: aicore 'Illegal instruction' -> 'ACL stream synchronize failed'
entries.fix: upgrade CANN (5.0->6.3->7.0 path reported); escalate to Ascend support

entries.title: GradScaler rejects fp16 gradients on both NPU (PTA ERR00002) and CUDA
entries.symptom: Attempting to unscale FP16 gradients; requires fp32 master weights
entries.root_cause: by-design contract: amp needs fp32 master
entries.fix: autocast + fp32 master + (T4: 8-bit optimizer); see DECISION_CARD R6/R7
